acceptance_predicates.description: After successful development broker admission, a PTY TUI remains running beyond 15 seconds and exits successfully only after an explicit quit or legitimate terminal lifecycle event.
Handshake, startup, malformed descriptor, and broker failures remain bounded and return typed failures without retaining a child.
Normal exit, child failure, and signal paths clean child process groups, broker workers, sockets, descriptors, and terminal state.
The inherited-fd/PTY and immutable source/binary identity qualification remains intact without weakened assertions.
Focused and applicable full tests, independent exact-head review, signed-DCO integration, required CI, merge, and post-merge validation succeed.

definition_of_done: Current ASB main no longer imposes a fixed runtime deadline on a healthy development asb-tui session, while startup and cleanup remain bounded and verified.

inputs.description: A current-main development installation launches asb-tui, closes after several seconds, and reports a terminal interface launch failure.
crates/asb-cli/src/tui.rs development broker path with a post-admission 15-second child deadline.

outputs.description: Reviewed ASB launcher implementation and deterministic PTY/process-cleanup tests.
Privacy-safe exact-main post-merge PTY validation evidence.

gates.description: A deterministic development PTY journey remains live beyond the previous 15-second deadline then exits deliberately.
Failure and normal paths prove broker/process/terminal cleanup.
Existing inherited-fd and PTY qualification passes unchanged.
Independent exact-head review, signed-DCO history, required CI, merge, and exact-main validation pass.
